prompt: can you rescan our google drive and update the knowledge base? i think we added some new folders recently

assertions.name: calls-drive-api
assertions.description: Agent actually calls the Drive API to list the current folder structure rather than just using cached KB data

assertions.name: compares-against-kb
assertions.description: Explicitly compares fetched Drive data against what personal/zenlabs.md currently says

assertions.name: produces-diff-report
assertions.description: Generates a structured reconciliation report showing unchanged/new/changed/outdated entries

assertions.name: waits-for-approval
assertions.description: Presents the changes and asks for user approval before applying (or in this test, indicates it would ask)

assertions.name: handles-structural-changes
assertions.description: Detects any new folders, renamed folders, or changed folder IDs in the Drive
